Kallithea · Halkidiki

Welcome to Ellie's Modern Haven

Discover a fresh and comfortable place to stay in Kallithea, Halkidiki. Ellie's Modern Haven combines contemporary design, a relaxing outdoor swimming pool and a central location close to the life of the village. It is an ideal base for enjoying the beaches, restaurants and atmosphere of Halkidiki.

The Apartment

Stay in Modern Comfort

Our newly built apartment has been designed to offer a bright, comfortable and relaxing holiday experience. Modern finishes, thoughtful details and practical living spaces create a welcoming base for your stay in Kallithea.

Location

Stay Close to Everything

Ellie's Modern Haven is located in a central area of Kallithea, Halkidiki, offering convenient access to shops, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants and the lively atmosphere of the village. The property is a comfortable base for discovering Kallithea and the wider Kassandra peninsula.
